title: A story whose tasks are all done and whose checks pass on main is done by the orchestrator without a worker session
goal: The kb-sprint run step, and backlog.py next or brief, name a story whose child tasks are all done and whose checks all pass on the current main as one the orchestrator lands with backlog.py land ID directly, without dispatching a worker that only re-runs its checks

run:
import sys, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir(parents=True)
def w(o): (d/(o['id']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(o))
w({'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'s','status':'active','goal':'g'})
def story(sid, code):
    w({'id':sid,'kind':'story','title':'story '+sid,'status':'todo','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P3','rank':0,'goal':'g',
       'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(%d)' % code]}]})
    for n in 'ab':
        w({'id':'TK-'+sid[3:9]+'a'+n,'kind':'task','title':'task','status':'done','parent':sid,'priority':'P3','rank':0,'goal':'g'})
story('ST-ggggggg2', 0); story('ST-hhhhhhh2', 1)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'next','--all'],capture_output=True,text=True)
mine = lambda sid: '\n'.join(l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if sid in l).lower()
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and 'land' in mine('ST-ggggggg2') and 'land' not in mine('ST-hhhhhhh2') else 1)

clauses.clause: backlog.py next or brief, name a story whose child tasks are all done and whose checks all pass on the current main as one the orchestrator lands with backlog.py land ID directly, without dispatching a worker that only re-runs its checks

notes: Retrospective of SP-g2ssvhi2: ST-h66j7wm5's worker (17 turns, about $0.28) made no commit: both child tasks TK-zqeq54ma and TK-2auyrlan had landed and both checks passed on main; the worker only verified them. operator request 2026-10-19 (housekeeping batch): a worker session per already-finished story is a model call a rule decides. Premise reproduced 2026-10-19 on origin/main 60a1f2d7b: backlog.py precheck ran its repro and checks and each failed before the work for the reason its goal names; the worker re-runs them first, since the code moves before this sprint runs.
